name: grommunio-documentation
versionComment: Deliberately no `version` field: this package is never published, and a stored semver would only ever be stale (it made every build report 1.0.0). The documentation version is derived from the checked-out commit at build time — see src/version.mjs and `npm run docs:version`.
description: grommunio documentation — Astro + Starlight, branded to match grommunio.com. Multi-book docs with global search, auto-generated man pages / admin CLI / OpenAPI, and PDF/EPUB exports.

scripts.gen:all: node scripts/gen-man-pages.mjs && node scripts/gen-admin-cli.mjs && node scripts/fetch-openapi.mjs && node scripts/gen-diagrams.mjs && node scripts/gen-dev-resources.mjs

overridesComment: Security fixes for transitive build-time dependencies (none reaches the browser). httpsnippet (via starlight-openapi) still pulls form-data <4.0.6 = GHSA-hmw2-7cc7-3qxx; `npm audit fix --force` would instead downgrade starlight-openapi, so the fixed transitive is pinned directly. Re-check on every dependency bump; drop an entry once the parent ships the fix itself.
devDependenciesComment: mermaid is held at 11.x on purpose: 12.0 changed text wrapping and layout so much (even with layout:dagre / look:classic pinned in scripts/gen-diagrams.mjs) that every architecture diagram re-flowed into tall, narrow, hard-to-read shapes. Re-evaluate on a later 12.x by running `npm run gen:diagrams` and comparing public/img/arch/*.svg before committing.
